info.title: StuHelper Storage API
info.description: Internal service and storage administration API. Current issuer/subject authorization is mandatory on every operation. Target replicas 3, initial publication 2; encryption deferred. Account domains and credential references are administrative data.

200.description: Verified complete content; no provider URL

get.description: Global operator-only snapshot requiring storage.operations.read. Bounded object and failed-job pages have independent cursors. No provider requests, credentials, provider paths or account identifiers are returned. Missing replicas do not imply an eligible replacement account exists.

post.description: Requires storage.operations.manage on the instance. Changes only the ledger; never logs in, probes or changes provider quotas. Atomic audit and idempotent response, current permission on replay.
Requires storage.operations.retry on the job and current object protection. Bounded queue admission and generation fencing. Never changes content access policy or bypasses account authorization.

get.description: Dedicated contribution service read grant, expected owner domain and contributor ownership required. Ledger only, no credentials or supplier calls.

put.description: Requires storage.contributions.manage. Monotonic permanent control revision prevents old workers reviving a paused/exiting contribution. First binding requires a verified paused empty contributor instance. Does not extend provider authorization.

get.description: Service-only owner-scoped ledger lookup of verified paused empty contributor instances; never probes suppliers or returns custody material.
Storage custody only. No contribution consent, admission expansion, or secret readback. Password input is write-only and excluded from logs. Original request IDs are retained for recovery.

client_key.description: Optional stable key scoped to the service principal. Its object identity survives the 24-hour request replay window; changed creation parameters conflict and deleted objects are not recreated.

InstanceCommand.description: Current instance revision required. limit_bytes is required only for quota. Resume applies only to paused, still-authorized instances; it does not renew authorization. Quota cannot fall below used plus reserved bytes.

RetryJob.description: Only blocked jobs with unchanged object, instance, credentials and intent can be retried. Reuses the original remote write identity; unknown writes remain subject to reconciliation.
